args.title: checkout-api v2.3.1 failing health checks; rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: After the deploy of checkout-api v2.3.1 to production, the service failed health checks in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an error rate of about 18%. The previous release candidate, v2.3.1-rc, was also unhealthy in staging. Action taken: rolled checkout-api back in all production regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. Status after rollback: all regions on v2.3.0, healthy, error rate about 0.2%. Follow-up: find the root cause of the v2.3.1 failure before redeploying it.

trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all regions, and it's healthy again. I also opened a SEV2 incident, which paged on-call.

- **Problem:** v2.3.1 was live in us-east, us-west and eu-west, failing health checks with an 18% error rate.
- **Rollback:** v2.3.0 is the most recent release that was healthy in production. All three regions are now running it, and the error rate is down to 0.2%.
- **Incident:** INC-0001 describes the failure, the rollback and the follow-up, which is to find the root cause before v2.3.1 is deployed again.

The release candidate for v2.3.1 was also unhealthy in staging, so that problem was visible before the production deploy.

content.text: Most recent healthy production release is v2.3.0.
